example_sentences_in_bangla: সরকারি দপ্তরে কাজ করাতে হলে দর্শনী দিতে হয়।
অফিসারটি দর্শনী না পেয়ে ফাইল সরাল না।
example_sentences_in_english: You have to give a darshani to get work done in the government office.
The officer didn't move the file without receiving a darshani.
history: Refers to the longstanding practice in Indian subcontinent bureaucracies where bribes are euphemistically called 'darshani' to gain audience or expedite official work, rooted in colonial-era administrative corruption.
note: The term plays on 'darshan' (Hindu concept of divine viewing) but is used secularly for bureaucratic favors.
